data.one_liner: String validation and sanitization library for Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of functions to validate emails, URLs, IPs, and other string patterns, as well as sanitizing input strings.
use_when: Sanitizing strings before storage or display
Implementing simple validation logic in Dart applications
avoid_when: You need complex, custom validation logic beyond simple checks
You prefer a declarative form builder with built‑in validation
weaknesses: No UI components or form integration helpers
